en.summary: Tuhu Auto Care has been announced as a gold partner for the 2026 World Skills Competition, marking its first collaboration with an international professional skills competition. Monetary policy is one of multiple factors influencing market performance.

en.summary: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority expects the Hong Kong dollar may face downward pressure against the US dollar following the Federal Reserve's rate increase, though the authority does not anticipate elevated credit risk from higher borrowing costs in the territory.
